interactive.welcome: Daily Agent · Plain input is classified locally before storage; /recent to view logs; /connections to analyze links; /exit to quit
tag.question: Open question
terminal.link:
Send /link {code} in Telegram.
The pairing code expires in 10 minutes and can only be used once.
telegram.start: Welcome to Daily Agent. Plain text is classified and analyzed only by the local Ollama model and is not sent to GLM; only explicit advanced features call GLM. First run `daily-agent link-telegram` in Terminal, then send `/link CODE` here.
telegram.linked: Pairing successful. You can now send logs directly.
telegram.invalid_pairing: The pairing code is invalid, expired, or already used. Generate a new one in Terminal.
telegram.not_linked: Not paired yet. Generate a pairing code in Terminal, then send `/link CODE`.
telegram.help:
Plain text: local Qwen storage decision, classification, and summary
/log TEXT: force save and analyze locally
/private TEXT: force save without model calls
/recent: recent logs
/connections: call GLM for advanced connection analysis
/delete ID: delete by ID
/delete -N: delete the Nth newest log, N from 1 to 10
/export: export JSON
/privacy: privacy information
telegram.privacy: Original text is stored in plaintext SQLite. Ordinary input is sent only to local Ollama. GLM is called only by explicit advanced features such as /connections, after local redaction. Telegram messages still pass through Telegram servers. Do not send passwords or other highly sensitive information.
telegram.private_saved: Saved in no-upload mode. GLM was not called.
telegram.analysis_pending: Saved, but AI analysis is not complete.
telegram.storage_ignored: This looks like a question, command, or general conversation, so it was not saved. Use /log to force saving.
telegram.storage_ask: I could not determine whether this should be saved, so it was not stored. Use /log to save it or /private to keep it local only.
telegram.truncated: …Output was too long and has been truncated
analysis.need_two_logs: At least two logs are required to analyze connections.
error.invalid_delete_position: Delete position must be from -1 to -10; for example, /delete -1 deletes the newest log
